Karasaev Kyrgyz State University, Reasons for the Results, Risks, and Strategic Steps for Improvement” for the university administration, deans, department chairs, and division heads.

The event was held in collaboration with the University of Hamburg and the German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD), and was co-organized by the “Taalim-Forum” Public Foundation, the Kyrgyz-German Institute of Applied Informatics, and Bishkek State University named after K. Karasayev. Participants: Students from Bishkek State University named after Karasayev, the Bishkek Municipal Pedagogical Institute, and Kyrgyz State University named after I. Arabayev. Link здесь
